assets.name: traveller
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game character animation sprite sheet, genuine transparent alpha background. Create a complete 8-frame slow, weighted walking cycle for one small anonymous adult traveller in a worn hooded charcoal coat, heavy boots, face entirely in shadow, a tiny dim lantern held close to their sternum. Facing screen right in a slightly elevated three-quarter game view. Monochrome charcoal and graphite illustration with carefully painted cloth folds and subtle grey edge lighting. Restrained physical horror, lonely, serious, no cartoon proportions, no glowing eyes, no outlines or neon. Exactly FOUR equal columns by TWO equal rows, eight separate full-body frames in reading order, regular cells, identical character scale and common foot baseline within every cell, ample transparent margins between figures. Sequence: right heel contact, weight down, passing, lift, left heel contact, weight down, passing, lift. Coat and lantern lag subtly with the stride. Smoothly consistent anatomy and costume across all frames. Entire bodies visible, each approximately 80% of its cell height. No floor, no cast shadow, no scenery, no grid lines, no labels, no text. Landscape 1536 by 1024.
